# splunkctl search

Search and job management.

## search cancel

Cancel a running search job.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl search cancel [OPTIONS] SID
```

## search export

Streaming export for large result sets.

```text
splunkctl search export [OPTIONS] SPL
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--earliest` | text | - | Earliest time. |
| `--latest` | text | - | Latest time. |
| `--app` | text | - | Splunk app context. |

## search job

Get status and results for a specific job.

```text
splunkctl search job [OPTIONS] SID
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--offset` | integer | 0 | Result offset for paging. |
| `--count` | integer | 0 | Max results (0=all). |
| `--events` | flag | false | Fetch raw events. |
| `--status-only` | flag | false | Show status without results. |

## search jobs

List running and recent search jobs (--filter matches the sid).

```text
splunkctl search jobs [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## search oneshot

Quick one-off search.

```text
splunkctl search oneshot [OPTIONS] SPL
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--earliest` | text | - | Earliest time. |
| `--latest` | text | - | Latest time. |
| `--limit` | integer | 100 | Max results (default 100). |
| `--app` | text | - | Splunk app context. |

## search run

Run a search synchronously and print results.

```text
splunkctl search run [OPTIONS] SPL
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--earliest` | text | - | Earliest time (e.g. -24h, -7d). |
| `--latest` | text | - | Latest time (e.g. now). |
| `--limit` | integer | 100 | Max results (default 100). |
| `--app` | text | - | Splunk app context. |
| `--detach` | flag | false | Submit job and exit without waiting. |

## search upload

Upload a local file into Splunk for indexing.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl search upload [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Reads the file from your laptop and sends it to the remote Splunk
instance via the receivers/simple REST endpoint.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | file | - | Local file to upload (CSV, log, JSON, etc.). [required] |
| `--index` | text | main | Target index. |
| `--sourcetype` | text | - | Source type (auto if omitted). |
| `--source` | text | - | Source label (defaults to filename). |
| `--host` | text | - | Host metadata. |
